name: opencode-hook-logger
description: hook-logger.ts opencode plugin (logs essentially every opencode hook event as JSONL under ~/opencode-hook-output/, for debugging/observability), packed and installed locally by extracting this tarball straight into opencode's own package cache under a bare name@version (no registry, no server - see CLAUDE.md). Written in TypeScript against @opencode-ai/plugin's Plugin type. Independently installable from llm-review-gate.ts - not bundled together. After editing hook-logger.ts, run `npm pack` in this directory to regenerate the committed opencode-hook-logger-1.0.0.tgz - tests/unit/plugins-tarball.test.mjs fails if it drifts from source.
